datasheet.revision: web product page captured 2026-11-10 (no document revision)

recommended_operating.conditions: power the valve for approximately one minute to charge the internal capacitor so the 2-wire auto return works when power is removed (FAQ 5 and note under 'Other models')

pins.notes: 2 Wire Auto Return wiring schematic: + to power through the switch (p21). Wire colours are not legible in the page images; lead numbering is not in the source (assigned here for mapping only).
2 Wire Auto Return wiring schematic: - to power return (p21).

layout_notes.text: Normally closed, 2-wire auto return: open while powered, closes automatically when power is switched off or lost (p17, p18 Operating State 'Normally Closed', p20).

'Once the valve opens, it mostly stops consuming power' (2-Wire Automatic Return Setup feature); designed with power-limiting features allowing continuous powering without overheating (Warning 5, p20).
Auto return relies on an internal capacitor charged while powered: keep the valve powered about one minute before switching off to guarantee the return to closed.
Enclosure IP65; enclose in a protective housing if permanently installed outdoors.
Derived bound, not a source value: I = Pmax / V with Pmax 5 W (p18) gives about 0.42 A at 12 V and 0.56 A at the 9 V minimum.

Warning 1: 2-wire reverse polarity and 3-wire models are de-energized when fully open or closed; other models (including this 2-wire auto return) may draw a negligible amount of power when fully open. Expect a small continuous draw while the valve is held open.

gaps: Source is a retail product web page printed to PDF (25 pages, image only, no extractable text); no manufacturer datasheet and no revision. Values read from rendered images (p14 title/SKU, p17, p18 specification table, p19 FAQ, p20 warnings, p21 wiring schematics).
No current rating: neither moving nor holding current is given, only 'Max Power 5 W' (p18).
No inrush current, no motor/capacitor charging current profile, and no statement on how much power is drawn once open beyond 'mostly stops consuming power' (p17).
Polarity sensitivity of the 2-wire auto return model not stated explicitly; the p21 schematic shows + and - marks. Behaviour with a freewheel diode or with reverse polarity is not documented.
Wire colours and lead lengths not legible/stated.
Spec table model is 'USS-MSV00008' (p18); SKU JFMSV00008 shown on the product title block (p14). Treated as the same product.
No AC vs DC difference in ratings given (single 9-24 V AC/DC range, p18).
